title: Reorganizing the RNA polymerase II complex for replication of an infectious noncoding RNA in vivo.
authors: Hao, Jie; Qin, Zhuan; Ma, Junfei; Qu, Jie; Wang, Yunhan; Folimonova, Svetlana Y; Liu, Bin; Li, Wenwei; Wang, Ying
one_liner_zh: 该文研究RNA聚合酶II在RNA模板上的重组及TFIIIA-7ZF介导的转录机制，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但涉及蛋白-核酸互作与AlphaFold3结构预测，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: DNA-dependent RNA polymerases (DdRPs) recognize not only DNA but also RNA templates. This RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRP) activity is exploited by bacterial 6S RNA, mammalian B2 RNA, viroids in plants, and hepatitis delta virus in human. A major knowledge gap exists regarding the molecular basis conferring this RdRP activity. Here, we provide evidence supporting the reorganization of the 12-subunit polymerase II (Pol II) to 7-subunit in vivo for PSTVd transcription. Rpb4/5/6/7/9 are not involved in PSTVd transcription in planta. A splicing variant of transcription factor IIIA with seven zinc finger domains (TFIIIA-7ZF) aids the remodeled Pol II in transcribing PSTVd. Using AlphaFold3, the structure of the remodeled Pol II with PSTVd RNA and TFIIIA-7ZF was predicted. The predicted structure and experimental data both show that the N-terminus of TFIIIA-7ZF binds to the left terminal domain of PSTVd, while the C-terminus interacts with Rpb2. Interestingly, AlphaFold3 also predicts the bending at PSTVd loop 8 in the TFIIIA-7ZF/PSTVd complex. Replacing this loop 8 with a rigid double-stranded conformation impairs the TFIIIA-7ZF/PSTVd interaction. Altogether, our data demonstrate the heterogenous organization of the Pol II enzyme on RNA template in vivo and provide structural insights into the organization of Pol II transcription complex on RNA template.
abstract_zh: DNA依赖性RNA聚合酶（DdRPs）不仅识别DNA模板，也识别RNA模板。这种RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶（RdRP）活性被细菌6S RNA、哺乳动物B2 RNA、植物类病毒以及人类丁型肝炎病毒所利用。关于赋予这种RdRP活性的分子基础，目前存在重大知识空白。在此，我们提供证据支持12亚基聚合酶II（Pol II）在体内重组为7亚基以进行PSTVd转录。Rpb4/5/6/7/9不参与植物体内PSTVd转录。具有七个锌指结构域的转录因子IIIA剪接变体（TFIIIA-7ZF）辅助重塑后的Pol II转录PSTVd。利用AlphaFold3，预测了重塑后Pol II与PSTVd RNA及TFIIIA-7ZF复合物的结构。预测结构和实验数据均显示，TFIIIA-7ZF的N端结合PSTVd的左端结构域，而C端与Rpb2相互作用。有趣的是，AlphaFold3还预测了TFIIIA-7ZF/PSTVd复合物中PSTVd环8处的弯曲。将该环8替换为刚性双链构象会损害TFIIIA-7ZF/PSTVd相互作用。总之，我们的数据证明了Pol II酶在体内RNA模板上的异质组织，并为RNA模板上Pol II转录复合物的组织提供了结构见解。
